title: Keep a fixed value
summary: Scala: Keep a fixed value. Start with 6 pencils.
introduction: val names a value that cannot be reassigned. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Keep a fixed value with Scala

blocks.text: Install Scala CLI. Save each example as lesson.scala and run scala run lesson.scala. These examples use Scala 3 syntax.

blocks.title: Keep a fixed value

blocks.text: val fixes pencils at 3. The sum produces 5 without reassignment.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use var only when reassignment is needed.
